---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| cache: true

income_tx <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  state = "TX",
  variables = "B19013_001",
  year = 2020,
  geometry = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
income_tx |>
  ggplot(aes(fill = estimate)) +
  geom_sf() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(labels = scales::dollar) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(
    title = "Median Household Income in Texas Counties",
    fill = "Income"
  )
```
